text: {"quantities": [{"id": "q1", "value": 100, "unit": "", "kind": "count", "span": "100 math problems total"}, {"id": "q2", "value": 12, "unit": "", "kind": "count", "span": "completes 12 problems on Monday"}, {"id": "q3", "value": 3, "unit": "", "kind": "count", "span": "3 times as many on Tuesday"}, {"id": "q4", "value": 4, "unit": "", "kind": "count", "span": "one-quarter (denominator)"}], "plan": [{"op": "mul", "args": ["q2", "q3"], "out": "s1", "note": "problems completed on Tuesday"}, {"op": "add", "args": ["q2", "s1"], "out": "s2", "note": "problems completed Monday plus Tuesday"}, {"op": "sub", "args": ["q1", "s2"], "out": "s3", "note": "problems remaining after Tuesday"}, {"op": "div", "args": ["s3", "q4"], "out": "s4", "note": "one-quarter of the remaining problems, done on Wednesday"}, {"op": "sub", "args": ["s3", "s4"], "out": "s5", "note": "problems left after Wednesday, for Thursday"}], "target": {"kind": "count", "scope": "math problems Chris has left to complete on Thursday"}, "dismissed": [{"value": 1, "reason": "the numerator 'one' in 'one-quarter' is an identity multiplier; dividing by 4 alone already gives one-quarter"}]}
